item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:15 HKT 16/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon affecting southern China will moderate over the weekend. A fresh easterly airstream will reach the coast of Guangdong on Sunday. A humid southerly airstream is expected to affect the coastal areas gradually early to midweek next week. There will be one or two showers over the region. A trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
